# Options: WebSocket API Reference

5 WebSocket endpoints. Start with [README.md](README.md) for this class's rules and gotchas.

Legend: `\*` = required parameter; `(.gt .gte …)` = comparison variants of that parameter
(e.g. `ticker.any_of=AAPL,MSFT`, `date.gte=2025-01-01`). **Plan** = cheapest individual plan that
includes the endpoint (`+`), then data recency and history depth per plan. Plan gates change: if a
call 403s on a listed plan, re-fetch the endpoint's doc page. Auth, envelope, and pagination rules:
[../foundations/README.md](../foundations/README.md).

## Feeds

### Aggregates (Per Minute)

`AM.<ticker>` · Delayed `wss://delayed.massive.com/options` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/options` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/options/aggregates-per-minute.md)

Stream minute-by-minute aggregated OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) and volume data for a specified options contract via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify an option contract or use * to subscribe to all option contracts. For business plans, the wildcard option is only available on the Full Market and Full Market Delayed expansions. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple optio…
- **Returns:** `ev sym v av op vw o c h l a z s e`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

### Aggregates (Per Second)

`A.<ticker>` · Delayed `wss://delayed.massive.com/options` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/options` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/options/aggregates-per-second.md)

Stream second-by-second aggregated OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) and volume data for a specified options contract via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify an option contract or use * to subscribe to all option contracts. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple option contracts. You can retrieve active options contracts from our Options Contracts API.
- **Returns:** `ev sym v av op vw o c h l a z s e`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

### Fair Market Value

`FMV.<ticker>` · Business `wss://business.massive.com/options` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/options/fair-market-value.md)

Stream real-time Fair Market Value (FMV) data for a specified options contract via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify an option contract. You're only allowed to subscribe to 1,000 option contracts per connection. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple option contracts. You can retrieve active options contracts from our Options Contracts API.
- **Returns:** `ev fmv sym t`
- **Plan:** Business plans only (Options Business) · recency Real-time

### Quotes

`Q.<ticker>` · Delayed `wss://delayed.massive.com/options` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/options` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/options/quotes.md)

Stream quote data for specified options contracts via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify an option contract. You're only allowed to subscribe to 1,000 option contracts per connection. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple option contracts. You can retrieve active options contracts from our Options Contracts API.
- **Returns:** `ev sym bx ax bp ap bs as t q`
- **Plan:** Advanced+ · recency Advanced Real-time

### Trades

`T.<ticker>` · Delayed `wss://delayed.massive.com/options` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/options` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/options/trades.md)

Stream tick-level trade data for option contracts via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify an option contract or use * to subscribe to all option contracts. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple option contracts. You can retrieve active options contracts from our Options Contracts API.
- **Returns:** `ev sym x p s c t q`
- **Plan:** Developer+ · recency Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time
